description.value: Cit-E Cycles is BC's largest e-bike retailer, operating 6 locations across the province with over 195 models from 20+ brands spanning urban commuters, cargo bikes, mountain, and touring e-bikes. The Vancouver (Kitsilano) store at 3155 W Broadway offers test rides and handles service and repairs. As a specialist e-bike shop, touring cyclists riding electric bikes will find knowledgeable staff and a wide parts and service ecosystem.
